tools.name: send_friend_request
tools.description: Send a friend request from the caller to a target user (ordered-pair, requester is the caller)
tools.sql: INSERT OR IGNORE INTO friendships (user_a, user_b, requester, status, a_login, b_login, created_at) VALUES (CASE WHEN :__user_id < :target_id THEN :__user_id ELSE :target_id END, CASE WHEN :__user_id < :target_id THEN :target_id ELSE :__user_id END, :__user_id, 'pending', CASE WHEN :__user_id < :target_id THEN :my_login ELSE :target_login END, CASE WHEN :__user_id < :target_id THEN :target_login ELSE :my_login END, :__now)

tools.name: list_friend_requests
tools.description: Pending incoming friend requests for the caller (requests the caller did not send)
tools.sql: SELECT user_a, user_b, requester, a_login, b_login, created_at FROM friendships WHERE (user_a = :__user_id OR user_b = :__user_id) AND status = 'pending' AND requester != :__user_id

tools.name: accept_friend_request
tools.description: Accept a pending friend request addressed to the caller (recipient only)
tools.sql: UPDATE friendships SET status = 'accepted', accepted_at = :__now WHERE user_a = CASE WHEN :__user_id < :other_id THEN :__user_id ELSE :other_id END AND user_b = CASE WHEN :__user_id < :other_id THEN :other_id ELSE :__user_id END AND status = 'pending' AND requester != :__user_id

tools.name: decline_friend_request
tools.description: Decline a pending friend request addressed to the caller (recipient only)
tools.sql: DELETE FROM friendships WHERE user_a = CASE WHEN :__user_id < :other_id THEN :__user_id ELSE :other_id END AND user_b = CASE WHEN :__user_id < :other_id THEN :other_id ELSE :__user_id END AND status = 'pending' AND requester != :__user_id

tools.name: list_friends
tools.sql: SELECT user_a, user_b, a_login, b_login, accepted_at FROM friendships WHERE (user_a = :__user_id OR user_b = :__user_id) AND status = 'accepted'

tools.name: remove_friend
tools.description: Remove a friendship (or withdraw a request) the caller is part of
tools.sql: DELETE FROM friendships WHERE user_a = CASE WHEN :__user_id < :other_id THEN :__user_id ELSE :other_id END AND user_b = CASE WHEN :__user_id < :other_id THEN :other_id ELSE :__user_id END
